definitions.explanation: One of the two endpoints of an axis, especially the North or South Pole of the Earth, or the positive/negative pole of a magnet or battery.
The farthest or highest point of something; the ultimate degree. Used in compounds and set phrases to indicate an extreme.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両極|りょうきょく}だ。
examples.english: The North Pole and South Pole are the two poles of the Earth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{磁石|じしゃく}→磁石：04211_jishaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧N{極|きょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧S{極|きょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A magnet has an N pole and an S pole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラス→プラス：00346_purasu⟧{極|きょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧{極|きょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えないで→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't mix up the positive and negative terminals of the battery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{両極端|りょうきょくたん}→両極端：20192_ryoukyokutan⟧だ。
examples.english: Their two opinions are at opposite extremes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: I reached the height of boredom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{振|ふ}れる→振る：01983_furu⟧。
examples.english: His behavior swings from one extreme to another.

notes:
USAGE:
As a standalone word, most often used in scientific contexts (geographic/magnetic poles). In the sense of "extreme," it primarily appears in compounds:
- ⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧: extreme (adjective)
- ⟦{両極端|りょうきょくたん}→両極端：20192_ryoukyokutan⟧: both extremes
- ⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧: North Pole
- ⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧: South Pole
- {陽極|ようきょく}: positive pole, anode
- {陰極|いんきょく}: negative pole, cathode

Note: When read as ごく, it is a prefix meaning "very, extremely" (⟦{極|ごく}→極：03816_goku⟧⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧, a very small number). That is a separate entry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- N{極|きょく}/S{極|きょく}: N pole / S pole
- {両極|りょうきょく}: both poles
- {極|きょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach the extreme
